eventDetail.scope: The IEEE World Forum on the Internet of Things (WF-IoT2026) is to be held in Abu Dhabi- UAE for the first time. WF-IoT seeks submissions and proposals for original technical papers and presentations that address the Internet of Things (IoT), its theoretical and technological building blocks, applications that drive the growth and evolution of the IoT, operational considerations, experimentation, and experiences from deployments. It also welcomes papers on the impacts of IoT on consumers, the research community, the public sector, and commercial and industrial sectors. The theme of WF-IoT2025 is “Connected and Resilient Ecosystems”, aiming to encourage submissions of content focusing on technology and application scenarios of smart IoT and its sustainability.
